text:
jamal: Heads-up — prototype for a 'cache half-life' metric landed on the cost dashboard. Idea: show how long cached prefixes effectively reduce token burn per route. Want product + eng-platform thoughts before we wire to billing.

ana: Nice. is this per-tenant or per-route? we need to avoid noisy spikes from bursts.

jamal: per-route by default, with tenant rollup. half-life computed as exponential decay fit on `cached_token_savings` over last 7d. quick sketch: `t_half = log(0.5)/lambda` — straightforward but noisy at low sample rates.

leo: Fit makes sense. we should surface sample rate + model SKU so folks see uncertainty. Suggest a `95% CI` and a small sampling badge, e.g. "sampled 12%".

maya: UX: don't over-surface math. show an 'uncertainty' pill and a 'how we compute it' flyout. also add a toggle to switch to sessionized view (credits per session vs per invocation).

jamal: agreed. another routing tie-in: when fallback routing occurs we should attribute observed savings to the served model variant (the one that actually cached) not the original route. otherwise numbers mislead.

ana: that breaks current chargeback rules. we currently allocate credits to the original route. If we change attribution we'll need a migration plan + advance notice to billing teams.

leo: compromise: show both. two columns — 'observed savings' (served variant) and 'billable allocation' (current chargeback). add a tiny footer explaining the diff + link to rollout docs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: proto dashboards deployed to staging at https://staging.console.redwood.dev/costs/half-life • PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4321 :rocket:

maya: QA ask: when quotas are hit and caching is disabled, half-life should drop to ~0. Need an alert if metric decays >80% in 1h or if sample_rate < 5%.

jamal: I'll add an event hook + alert rule. Also proposing a small internal API `GET /v1/costs/half_life?route=...` that returns `t_half`, `ci`, `sample_rate`, `model_sku` — internal-only. Any objections?

leo: API shape + fields look good. enforce internal service tokens only, rate limit to 10r/s. add `model_sku` and `route_version` params.

ana: rollout plan: opt-in per-tenant. show metric in 'beta dashboards' first and DO NOT feed to billing until we validate for Q2. send notice to finance + CS.

jamal: sounds good. I'll update the PR with opt-in flag, alert rules, and a migration note for billing. cc @maya for UX copy. :+1:

maya: on it — will draft tooltip + flyout copy and mock the session toggle. should have copy by EOD. :eyes:
